# CabacaTech

CabacaTech is the personal website and portfolio of Tiago Cabaça.

## About Tiago Cabaça

Tiago Cabaça is a developer and informatics student based in Lisbon, Portugal. He studies computer engineering and management informatics at IADE, works on web development projects, and is available for freelance work.

He builds websites, web apps, APIs, technical tools and open source projects. His main technologies include JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, Kotlin, SQL and Git.

## Projects

- PSP Lisboa App: Android application project related to PSP Lisboa.
- Track Manager: open source web app for managing audio and subtitle tracks in video files, using React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, FFmpeg and MKVToolNix.
- Africana Virtual Airways: full stack flight booking platform with search, seat selection, PNR and administration backoffice.
- Xplored: Android project created in an academic context.

## Services

Tiago Cabaça offers freelance services in web development, UI/UX design, technical consulting, performance optimization and technical SEO.
